# TestScript for 07-dynamic-validation
# Asserts conga.Validator programmatic cross-field validation

# 1. Valid default run
exec validator-demo
stdout '⚙  validator-demo'
stdout '--start-date\s+string\s+2026-01-01\s+· default'
stdout '--end-date\s+string\s+2026-01-31\s+· default'
stdout '--max-retries\s+int\s+3\s+· default'
stdout '--backoff\s+time\.Duration\s+1s\s+· default'

# 2. Valid custom date range
exec validator-demo --start-date 2026-06-01 --end-date 2026-06-30 --max-retries 5 --backoff 2s
stdout '--start-date\s+string\s+2026-06-01\s+● cli --start-date'
stdout '--end-date\s+string\s+2026-06-30\s+● cli --end-date'
stdout '--max-retries\s+int\s+5\s+● cli --max-retries'
stdout '--backoff\s+time\.Duration\s+2s\s+● cli --backoff'

# 3. Cross-field validation failure: end-date before start-date
exit-status 2 validator-demo --start-date 2026-12-01 --end-date 2026-01-01
stderr 'end-date \(2026-01-01\) cannot be earlier than start-date \(2026-12-01\)'

# 4. Invalid date format
exit-status 2 validator-demo --start-date not-a-date
stderr 'invalid start-date format'

# 5. Invalid zero backoff when max-retries > 0
exit-status 2 validator-demo --max-retries 5 --backoff 0s
stderr 'backoff duration must be positive when max-retries > 0'
